summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The 41 tests in the new module and test/test_path.py pass. Nothing is committed. mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading the code only; lines are within 88 columns. Judgment calls: None and plain str are rejected via an exact-type check before graph lookup (blank nodes are str subclasses); the pytest.raises opening lines carry no type-ignore, the parser call line does; the unclosed-list test uses labelled blank nodes.
